hints.visible: Off keeps the post as a draft only its authors and staff can open.
hints.publishOn: Empty means now. A shown post with a later time stays hidden until then.
hints.sticky: Kept at the top of the lists.
hints.globalPost: Listed on the home page and the global newsfeed.
hints.summary: Shown in lists instead of the start of the post. Empty uses the content.
hints.ogImage: An https URL or a site path such as /static/banner.png. Empty for none.

stateHint.draft: Only authors and staff can open it.
stateHint.scheduled: Goes public by itself at the publish time.

errors.title: Enter a title of at most {max} characters.
errors.ogImage: Use an http(s) URL or a path starting with /, at most 150 characters.
errors.publishOn: Pick a valid date and time.

delete.title: Delete “{title}”?
delete.body: The post and its whole discussion are deleted for good. Contribution points are recomputed.
